purpose: WP4.5 rights-audit inventory prepared for owner sign-off; not a rights verification.

RF01.title: Lookalike of a proprietary OS logo
RF01.detail: Four-pane perspective window mark / wallpaper emblem evokes the Windows 10 logo; AGENTS.md forbids copying proprietary logos.
RF01.recommended_action: Replace the four-pane mark with an unmistakably original penguin/bowl mark, or record an explicit owner risk acceptance.
RF01.resolution: ten-start.svg, ten-blue.jpg, ten-midnight.jpg replaced by original bowl-of-light artwork from scripts/build_original_artwork.py; no four-pane mark remains.

RF02.title: Composition modelled on a proprietary default wallpaper
RF02.detail: Light-beam hero composition modelled on the Windows 10 default wallpaper.
RF02.recommended_action: Owner visual comparison; redraw the beam geometry or accept the risk in writing.
RF02.resolution: windows10-bloom.svg and the ten wallpapers redrawn as a fan of rays and ripples rising from a bowl (different composition from the Windows 10 hero image).

RF03.title: Likely lookalike of a proprietary wallpaper, source undocumented
RF03.detail: Photographic green-hill / blue-sky / cloud scene evoking Windows XP 'Bliss'; no generator produces these bytes and no author, tool or prompt is recorded.
RF03.recommended_action: Owner to confirm provenance and generation records, or replace with a clearly original scene.
RF03.resolution: luna-hills.jpg replaced by a procedurally drawn terraced-ridge dusk scene (scripts/build_original_artwork.py).

RF04.title: Raster artwork with undocumented origin
RF04.detail: Hand-reviewed raster not reproduced by any in-repo generator and not named in CONTRIBUTORS.md.
RF04.recommended_action: Record author/tool, generation prompt and terms of use, or replace.
RF04.resolution: luna-hills.jpg now has a generator and provenance; frutiger-future.jpg remains open.

RF05.title: AI-generated artwork: no per-file record
RF05.detail: CONTRIBUTORS.md says it was generated with OpenAI image tools; prompts, date, account terms and any style reference are not recorded. AI output may not carry copyright, and the 'Aero Seven' names/Frutiger-Aero look imitate Windows 7 era artwork.
RF05.recommended_action: Archive prompts and generation records, confirm the tool terms allow MIT redistribution, and confirm no proprietary reference image was supplied.

RF06.title: Third-party brand palette in a logo
RF06.detail: 2x2 rounded squares in the exact Google brand colours (#4285f4 #ea4335 #fbbc04 #34a853).
RF06.recommended_action: Recolour to a RiceBowl palette or replace the mark.
RF06.resolution: ricebowl-chrome-start.svg is a bowl-in-circle launcher glyph in the RiceBowl Chrome palette; no Google brand colours.

RF07.title: Bundled font bytes not matched to an upstream release
RF07.detail: Internal version string is Liberation Sans 2.1.5 (OFL-1.1) but the sha256 differs from Debian fonts-liberation's file of the same version; unmodified status (OFL reserved font name 'Liberation') is therefore unverified.
RF07.recommended_action: Compare against the upstream 2.1.5 release tarball; if modified, rename or replace.
RF07.resolution: Old file differed from Debian's 2.1.5 only in the FFTM build timestamp and derived checksums (unmodified rebuild); replaced by the checksummed Debian/Ubuntu fonts-liberation 1:2.1.5-3 file; assets/fonts/PROVENANCE.md. Upstream tarball comparison remains an owner task.

RF08.title: OFL notice not confirmed in packaged builds
RF08.detail: The font is embedded in the native binary via include_bytes!, but the Debian build scripts install no copyright/licence file for it.
RF08.recommended_action: Ship assets/fonts/LiberationSans-LICENSE.txt in every package that embeds the font.
RF08.resolution: ricebowl-riceplate-native installs copyright and LiberationSans-LICENSE.txt under /usr/share/doc/ricebowl-riceplate-native/; verify_wayland_package_set.sh enforces it.

RF09.title: Tracked bytes differ from generator output
RF09.detail: The in-repo generator rebuilds this file with different bytes, so the tracked version was edited by hand or by an earlier generator revision and is not reproducible.
RF09.recommended_action: Owner accepts hand edits as original or re-commits generator output.

RF10.title: Documentation capture of OS-imitating UI
RF10.detail: Real screenshot containing flagged wallpapers/logos and third-party application UI (Thunar, GTK widgets, system fonts). Not a runtime asset.
RF10.recommended_action: Resolve the flags on the artwork shown; confirm screenshots are acceptable to publish.

RF11.title: Penguin mascot resembles Tux
RF11.detail: Linux penguin artwork is declared original, but Tux (Larry Ewing) is a licensed work.
RF11.recommended_action: Owner confirms the drawings are independent, or adds Tux attribution.

RF12.title: macOS-styled glyph or tile
RF12.detail: Rounded-tile Control-Center style icon in Apple's system blue (#0a84ff); filename names macOS.
RF12.recommended_action: Owner visual comparison against Apple artwork; rename if needed.

RF13.title: Proprietary font names referenced
RF13.detail: CSS names proprietary families (e.g. Tahoma, Segoe UI) only as fallbacks; no such font file is shipped.
RF13.recommended_action: None required beyond confirming no proprietary font is bundled.

RF14.title: Bundled recipe carries no provenance block
RF14.detail: Bundled example/default recipe has no author, licence or origin field; it references wallpapers and the bundled font by name.
RF14.recommended_action: Attach provenance when the recipe is published as a RicePack.
